summary: Reorder product for Wireless Speaker X: late deliveries left the shelf short (Evidence Support Score 1.00).
recommendation: Reorder product: Create a purchase order to restock a product before it runs out. Target: Wireless Speaker X.
hypothesis_label: Late deliveries left the shelf short
problem_statement: STOCKOUT_RISK (CRITICAL): Wireless Speaker X may run out within a day. Conclusion: The available evidence strongly supports late deliveries left the shelf short as the risk driver (Evidence Support Score 1.00), with demand jumped faster than stock was replenished as a contributing factor (0.98).
rationale: SUPPLIER_DELAY_SHORTAGE is strongly supported by the available records (Evidence Support Score 1.00; evidence 34756a4b-331f-4f80-80b4-59fc93a7b32b, 4efe8e94-6630-42fe-ba2d-3efcc20485a7, 22376687-09c2-489e-9633-456f57d4532b, 5d6ba2ee-3739-4931-89e9-12291e5b24ba, fa51d77a-a3a3-4ece-87e3-beecbe82f2ec). 1 open purchase order is overdue (by up to 1 day) SoundWave Wholesale: 50% of deliveries in the last 45 days were late (normal 13%) SoundWave Wholesale: 3 of the last 6 deliveries arrived late Out of stock on 2 of the last 14 days The deterministic impact estimate attached to this decision quantifies the exposure; the recommended action is the catalogue default for this conclusion.
required_actions: Simulated purchase order created for the supplier.

alternatives.tradeoff: Put the product or supplier on a watchlist with alert thresholds.
Open a demand review for a product, a category or the whole business before changing stock plans.

risks: Cash is tied up in the new stock until it sells.
